Late one evening, Harm receives a message from his ex-girlfriend. Harm returns the call and is devastated to find out that Parker is dead. Eager to help, Harm immediately makes plans to meet with Agent Kenworthy who will be leading the NCIS investigation.
When Captain Huddleston hears that the marine corporal has been charged with rape, he sends Lt. Colonel Sarah Mac MacKenzie to handle the case in a hot zone of Anti-American activity.

An intruder shoots three Navy people, killing two. One of the dead is a friend of Harm, who protects his reputation. Webb, counter-espionage, and disinformation are involved; Bud solves it. Mac and Renee return to town; Mac leaves again.

Capt. Shepard leads his troop off its peacekeeping mission and into battle with the colonel of the rebel forces. Consequently, six marines die in the public incident. Harm is sent in to investigate despite a recent touch of bad luck in a string of trials.

The JAG gang takes part in a JAGathon, a charity-benefit marathon, which provides opportunities for personal pride and individual competitiveness. Sturgis feels uncertain, and Harm defends a sailor for impersonating an officer.

A spotter on the ground calls for an airstrike as he has identified 15 heavily armed suspected Al Qaeda members on horseback. JAG won’t approve the airstrike until the spotter is absolutely certain the men are Al Qaeda members.

An ambulance pulls up to a crash site where a woman, Jennifer Wilson, is found injured and crying for her baby. Unbeknownst to her, the six-month-old baby died in the accident. A Navy judge stands accused of vehicular homicide.

Central Command coordinates an airstrike on a confirmed target traveling through Afghanistan. After the strike is launched, marine troops assess the damage and they are disturbed to learn that they targeted the wrong vehicle and hit civilians instead.

A deputy sheriff dies while chasing a car carrying two SEALs in a Navy exercise. The driver stands trial for negligent homicide.

Harm serves as a judge and Mac is the contentious prosecutor in a case fraught withpolitical implications when an American aviator is charged with killing three Britishsoldiers during a flight mission in Afghanistan.

When a Gulf War MIA victim is found as the sheik’s wife in a  nomadic Arab tribe, Bud prosecutes and Mac defends her against charges of desertion and, in a stunning turn of events, treason. Harm tries to get his old job back but is turned away.
JAG: The One That Got Away

Steven er dygtig hjertekirurg og gift med Anna, der er respekteret øjenlæge. De lever lykkeligt med deres to børn. Steven er ven med den 16-årige Martin, som er forældreløs. Tingene tager en mørk drejning, da Steven introducerer Martin for familien.

Rory MacNeil er en barsk mand, der modvilligt forlader sine elskede Hebriderne og rejser til San Francisco for at søge lægebehandling. Han flytter ind hos sin søn og hans familie, og hans liv er fuldstændig forandret af hans kærlighed til sit barnebarn.
En nyligt skilt kvinde får muligheden for at genopleve sin fortid, da hun møder en ung mand, der tilsyneladende er hendes gymnasie kæreste, der døde mange år tidligere.
”Wonder Wheel” er historien om fire menneskers liv, der flettes sammen i en charmerende og travl forlystelsespark på Coney Island.

I Mumbai bringer en frokostlevering to skæbner sammen: Enkemanden, Saajan, modtager ved en fejl den frokost som husmoderen, Ila, har tilberedt til sin mand. Måltidet bliver starten på en brevudveksling i madkassen om passion, længsel og fremtidshåb.

Ryan Bingham lever et højtsvævende liv. Han flyver over hele verden på forretningsrejser og er stadig på farten. Men så møder han medpassageren Alex og lærer, at livet ikke handler om rejsen, men om kontakterne man får på vejen.

Lars Lindstrom er en elskelig indadvendt mand, hvis emotionelle bagage har afholdt ham fra at udforske livet. Efter flere års ensomhed inviterer han Bianca, en ven han har mødt på internettet. Han introducerer Bianca for sin bror, Gus og hans kone, Karen.

Colin og Les opdrætter prisvindende får på en gård i et lille australsk samfund. Da en sygdom spreder sig blandt dyrene, og myndighederne beslutter, at alle fårene i dalen skal aflives, må mændene arbejde sammen for at redde deres levebrød.

Ryan (Freddie Prinze, Jr.) og Jennifer (Claire Forlani) kunne ikke være mere forskellige. Som børn hadede de hinanden. Som voksne binder deres forskelle dem sammen i denne sjove RomCom fra instruktøren bag SHE'S ALL THAT.
